correctness.rationale: Reconstructed cubic mask basis for H^0(-K)=cubics through two named F2 points, and full geometric smoothness iff the degree-four Macaulay map on quadratic multiples of the three partials has rank15 (regular sequence versus common projective zero). Independently constructed a different rank-elimination program, obtaining 60 smooth masks out of 255 and 104 smooth pencils. Independent rational incidence and members evaluation recovered exactly five point-count multisets with frequencies 8,24,24,24,24. For all 13 distinct orbit representatives, independently recomputed F2 affine lexicographic Groebner ideals and verified squarefree degree-seven eliminants, with factor-degree patterns (1,6) six reps, (7) four, (2,5) three. The two fixed infinity base points give Bezout total9, so base on blowup is reduced of length7. Eight rational projective automorphisms act freely on pencils (orbit-size eight); 13 reps exhaust 104. No 3D all-smooth linear subsystem by noninjective differential map at a marked base point.
